Patch notes

Bestiary

See every enemy up close on the field. Drag to move, pinch to zoom, twist with two fingers to rotate.

Accounts

Keep several saves on this device. Every account is stored here and you can switch between them any time. Each one also has its own save code.

Settings

Every on/off option in one place, plus the camera field of view.

Testing tools

Developer mode makes gold, gems, crowns and scraps unlimited, unlocks every scroll, hero and tower at level 1, and adds a developer menu to every run (the wrench under the pause button) that forces the Blood Moon, Starfall, the Wandering Merchant or an Ill Omen and spawns Scroll Bearers and Gem Carriers. Turning it off puts your account back the way it was. This is only for testing and will be removed before release.

Kingsgaard transfer

The open world is now its own game, Kingsgaard, with its own saves. Your heroes, spells and any open-world run you had are kept here. To bring them over, copy this code and paste it into Kingsgaard (Load > Import save code). Nothing is removed from this game.
